verdict.rationale: Fireflies has a public pricing page (fireflies.ai/pricing) that lists features such as AskFred, real-time notes, team analytics, multi-language mode and audit logs, and its docs refer to a named "Business Tier". That is thin, glancing evidence of self-serve tier information, but the pack shows no prices, no free plan and no mapping of features to tiers. missing for 10: evidence of a free starting plan, explicit per-tier prices, a per-tier feature comparison, confirmation that basic tiers need no sales contact, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use

citations.quote: Complimentary access to all Business Tier features, tools, and resources
